title: Fix the Unvalidated Number Parsing
description: The program should read a numeric string and print double its value.
expectedBehavior: For genuinely numeric input, the program should print double the value; for non-numeric input, it should report the problem instead of crashing.
actualProblem: Integer.parseInt("twenty") cannot convert a non-numeric word into an integer and throws an uncaught NumberFormatException, crashing the program.
explanation: Integer.parseInt() only accepts strings that represent valid integers and throws NumberFormatException for anything else. User-supplied or external strings should be parsed inside a try/catch so invalid input is handled gracefully.
